features_verified.feature: Turn Signal SVG Filter Glow Fix
features_verified.details: TurnArrow component in WarningPanel.jsx uses SVG filter approach instead of CSS drop-shadow stacking. Both turn-glow-left and turn-glow-right filters present in DOM. Turn signals blink correctly with green glow effect.

FuelGauge, CoolantGauge, BatteryGauge, OilPressureGauge components from InfoGauges.jsx visible on main dashboard. Left side: Coolant + Oil Pressure. Right side: Fuel + Battery. All gauges show dynamic values from vehicle simulation.
Dashboard layout clean with info gauges flanking main RPM/Speed gauges. Warning panel at bottom. Turn signals in top center area. No visual issues detected.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx correctly imports and positions FuelGauge, CoolantGauge, BatteryGauge, OilPressureGauge from InfoGauges.jsx
WarningPanel.jsx TurnArrow component correctly implements SVG filter glow with feGaussianBlur and feColorMatrix
InfoGauges.jsx uses useVehicleSignal hook to get real-time data from VehicleDataContext
VehicleDataContext.js DEFAULT_SIGNALS includes all required fields: fuel_pct, coolant_temp_c, oil_pressure_psi, battery_voltage
Backend server.py VehicleSimulator correctly generates all info gauge signals
